SUCCESS CRITERIA The operator authorizes the actual self-maintenance objective ONCE through a genuine native approval interaction. SAIPEN verifies and persists that explicit bounded grant. ZAICODE then executes multiple genuine successor turns without the operator repeatedly typing cc. Each completed bounded task is followed by independent discovery of the next eligible task while the grant, scheduler and budget remain valid. The operator is asked again only for a genuinely new authorization boundary, expiration, revocation, protected operation or unavailable human decision. If actual host integration is unavailable, identify the exact missing owning component and stop honestly rather than manufacturing a successful test.
